gavinlordofpugs: Henrik Gavinlordofp introduced himself as a lamplighter from Esterhaus. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A sniper's bullet hit Henrik Gavinlordofp at R-F5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao).
le.mrsh_: Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh reached R-F16 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh has learnt to recognise the ration cart by its squeaking wheel. A different squeak caused considerable disappointment this afternoon. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
